description: This file defines the 'ProxyInterfaceDescription' class within the Orleans CodeGenerator project. It models proxy interface metadata, manages method extraction, name handling, validation of a base class, and provides diagnostic support for code generation processes related to Orleans proxies.

classes.name: ProxyInterfaceDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of a proxy interface for Orleans code generation, including methods for validation, method extraction, and name handling.

methods.name: GetMethods
methods.description: Retrieves all non-explicit interface methods associated with the proxy, including inherited interfaces.

methods.name: ValidateBaseClass
methods.description: Validates that the provided base class contains appropriate 'InvokeAsync' method overloads with expected signatures.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between two ProxyInterfaceDescription instances based on InterfaceType and ProxyBaseType.
